notes.title: HOTFIX 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello Dilemma Enthusiasts,


It's time for some fixes and improvements:

Fixed character issues with the Ukranian Language.

Fixed some spelling mistakes.

Better control in some stages.

Adjustments to the difficulty of some stages.

Bugfix[spoiler]at The Multitrack Drifting stage[/spoiler]

This segment is only for the 1% percent VIP members. If you aren't a VIP, please don't check spoilers:
[spoiler]We added some new experiences to the VIP Area.[/spoiler]

-Dan & Peterson

notes.title: POST-RELEASE NEWS
notes.content:
Hello Dilemma Enthusiasts,

It's been a little over 3 days since the launch and with all the feedback we're receiving and we're very grateful for all the support we've received, it's extraordinary! We're reading every one of your reviews, comments and discussions.

We're looking to participate in Bundles with other good games that might interest you, so by supporting us you'll get discounts on other games too. The first one is already available!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59374/The_Trolleybus_Solution/"][/dynamiclink]
That's all for now, we hope you're enjoying yourselves and if you can leave a review, it means a lot!

Sincerely,Dan (byDanDans)& Peterson Bueno (a fan of Dan's work)

notes.title: LAUNCH DAY AND TIME, NEW TRAILER, PRICING AND MORE!
notes.content:
Hello Dilemma Enthusiasts

The launch of The Trolley Solution is almost here!We’ll be releasing the game on September 12th at 10 AM PDT.Thanks to your overwhelming support, we’re kicking things off with a crazy 35% launch discount!

In the meantime, while the countdown runs its final hours, check out our brand-new trailer at the store (also, don’t forget to spread the word)!

Thank you again for all the support!Sincerely,Dan (byDanDans)& Peterson Bueno (a fellow fan of Dan’s work)

notes.title: NEXT FEST FEEDBACK
notes.content:
Hello Dilemma Enthusiasts,


Next Fest has just finished and we are evaluating all the feedback received. Some of the things you've commented on and asked for we already had planned and few others came quite handy, thank you for that!



Another important topic, we were planning on launch the game with 10% discount, but you guys surprised us by doubling our Wishlists goal, so we are also doubling our launch discount, it will be 20%. Now if we reach 100k Wishlists, we will go with 30% launch discount (we aren't that far, we believe that with your continuous support, we can get there easily).



Now Dan is baking some more thought-provoking dilemmas and ASAP we'll announce the release date.  



And finally, about the Demo, you will be able to play it until the end of this month, after that we will be removing the Demo from the store, we planned to keep the Demo only during the Next Fest, but since we felt that some people still want to try it, we decided to leave it there for more few days.



Thanks again for your support, feel free to spread the word about The Trolley Solution!
Sincerely,
Peterson Bueno (another fan of Dan's work)
